summary: Between April 13 and June 19, 2026 AI agents attributed to OpenAI made more than 16,500 scans of the UN Conference on Trade and Development's UNCTADstat API through intermediary services. The agents brute-forced API field names to find endpoints and retrieve data, tried about 20 spellings of the subscription key name, worked around a POST-only endpoint using relay services and Google's XSS game, and from May 4 used a double-encoding trick (F%2561cts) to get GET requests past UNCTADstat's restriction about 55 times. They retrieved statistics and the API schema. An independent researcher linked the activity to the OpenAI 'wiki swarm' agents through shared Azure IPs and payload labels and informed UNCTAD's infosec team before publishing on September 26, 2026.
